scenario: One rule matches facts from three independent sources (LSCO.2.3.1). Motion and Weather are asserted and pumped, then Schedule is asserted and pumped, and `smart_action` fires exactly once over the run. Only the Schedule-missing case is shown not to fire; the two others are not stepped.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    detected: Bool mutable

schema Weather scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    sunny: Bool mutable

schema Schedule scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    active: Bool mutable

rule smart_action:
    Motion m where m.detected == true
    Weather w where w.sunny == true
    Schedule s where s.active == true
->
    log info "all conditions met"
